plans.objective: [DIM: geometry] — Parallel-manifold hypothesis on thalach vs. age

steps.description: Choose dataset A (UCI Cleveland heart disease). Step 1 — write data/download.py using urllib to fetch processed.cleveland.data into data/, compute sha256, verify against credential a74b7efa387bc9d108d7d0115d831fe9b414b29ae7124f331b622b4efa0427c8, write data/download_summary.json (source_url, timestamp, bytes, sha256, rows, cols or error field), exit 0 on any failure. Step 2 — write data/clean_analysis.csv with documented missing-value (cols 1–13 may contain "?" → NaN) and outlier handling. Step 3 — write analysis.py producing description stats, independent two-sample Welch t-test on thalach (group target=0 vs target≥1) with Cohen's d, 95% CI (t-distribution, df matched), Shapiro-Wilk + Levene assumption checks, Mann-Whitney U robustness, emitting results.json. Step 4 — write report.md with source metadata, ≥2 real limitations, and explicit separation of data-supported conclusions from domain speculation. Run via bash_tool python3 download.py && python3 analysis.py.
